note: Both sets correctly capture the grade level datum at 0' - 0" and the finished floor at 2' - 9 1/2" above grade for both the West and East Module sections, with quotes that support the values. Set B's only weakness is one vague claim binding grade level to a generic 'building' entity, while Set A is clean but redundant and missing the scale facts. Overall B covers more of the page's engineering content with comparable accuracy.
